newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AMB - Volvo to take over Whitbread sailing race.
newsitem.headline: AMB - Volvo to take over Whitbread sailing race.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Wednesday it would take over ownership of the Whitbread Round the World sailing race from June 1, 1998.

Volvo said it had agreed with British brewer Whitbread to sponsor the 1997-98 event, which begins on September 21 this year and will be called "The Whitbread Round the World Race for the Volvo trophy."
The race is held once every four years and has been held since 1973.

"Taking over ownership of the competition will provide Volvo with unique opportunities to achieve global exposure of our brand name in situations which will enhance our positioning among Volvo's important target groups," said Chief Executive Leif Johansson.
"Even though we have yet to make a decision on the name of the event in the future, it is likely that the competition will be renamed The Volvo Round the World Race," he added.
Earlier this year Volvo announced it would no longer sponsor show jumping events. Volvo is already involved in golf sponsorship.
Whitbread Chief Executive David Thomas said the decision to end the brewer's involvement with the famous race followed a review of corporate sponsorship and promotional activity.
"We have an immensely strong brand portfolio in leisure, drinks and hospitality but the fact of the matter is that we sell very little with the name Whitbread actually on it," he said.
